scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.dev: BACKEND_PORT=8081 concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "backend,ui" -c "blue,green" "npm run backend" "npm run ui"
scripts.dev:8081: BACKEND_PORT=8081 concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "backend,ui" -c "blue,green" "npm run backend" "npm run ui"
scripts.stop: lsof -ti:8080 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:8081 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:3000 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo '■ Stopped all servers'
